checklist: screen -v: 'Screen version 5.0.1 (build on 2025-05-15 15:05:28)', the pinned source.epoch (5.0.1-11, #497; up to -10 the build day, so no two builds had the same bytes)
screen -ls with no sessions: 'No Sockets found in /root/.screen.', rc 1
screen -dmS hs sleep 30: rc 0; -ls lists <pid>.hs, '1 Socket'; -S hs -X quit rc 0; -ls empty again
window fork + exec keeps the pid (slicc-kernel#176): the window's $PPID is the screen server from -ls, and /proc/<its pid> is the program
pty: screen bash --norc -i, alternate screen, echo in-$((6*7)) → in-42, exit → '[screen is terminating]', status 0

reattach from a second terminal (homescoop#162, slicc-kernel 1.35.1 / #210): detach in terminal A; terminal B's /dev/ttyN is visible from inside the session; screen -r attaches ($STY set), the window still shows A's output, a command runs, '[screen is terminating]', no session left

users (users enforce, 5.0.1-10): screen links the slicc credentials and keeps each user's sockets in ~/.screen (700; the package no longer sets SCREENDIR=/tmp/screens). scoop-a starts a session first, then cone starts one too (rc 0); each -ls lists only its own; scoop-a gets 'Permission denied' on cone's ~/.screen, and its -X quit, -r and -x of cone's session find nothing, and the same for cone towards scoop-a; each quits its own. 5.0.1-9: whoever starts first owns /tmp/screens (700), and the other user's -dmS fails silently (NEGATIVE.md)

cert/query.mjs (5.0.1-14, homescoop#662): on a detached session with a second window, screen -Q windows prints nothing, -Q windows '%n %t|' prints '0 bash|1 two|' and -Q title 'two'. Native screen 5.0.1 (built from the same tarball on macOS) prints the same three lines: with no display, ShowWindows(-1) lists nothing. This is upstream behaviour, and the README says so

cert/docs.mjs (5.0.1-16, homescoop#1600): the tarball's README is the committed package/README.md and has a ## <version> section; there is no recipe-root packages/screen/README.md and build.sh copies no README (it fails if one comes back). 5.0.1-15's tarball README is the old recipe-root copy, with no ## 5.0.1-15 section (NEGATIVE.md). homescoop#1661: recipe.yaml notes say the package no longer sets SCREENDIR and reattach needs slicc-kernel >= 1.35.1; main's notes before #1661 ('package sets SCREENDIR=/tmp/screens', 'fails until slicc-kernel#192') fail it (NEGATIVE.md)

cert/stuff-log.mjs (5.0.1-16, homescoop#1485): screen -L -Logfile F -dmS L bash --norc; -X stuff 'echo logged-$((6*7))\n' runs it in the window; -X hardcopy H and the -L log both hold a logged-42 line after -X quit. Coverage: 5.0.1-15 passes too; the prove-negative tarball (empty wasm) fails it
